name: BGLD deflationary transfer and migration
summary: The old BGLD token's deflationary transfer burns from the liquidity pair's own balance without sync(), so the attacker skimmed the imbalance out of the WBNB pair and then ran the surplus through the migration proxy into newBGLD.

loss.notes: Migrated from legacy lossUsd/lossOther. The legacy corpus did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.
